questions.q: any double charges on the amex card
questions.truth: (() => { const T = DB.txns.filter(t => /amex/i.test((DB.accounts.find(a => a.id === t.acct) || {}).name || '')); for (let i = 0; i < T.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < T.length; j++) if (T[i].amt === T[j].amt && String(T[i].desc).slice(0, 10) === String(T[j].desc).slice(0, 10) && Math.abs(dayDiff(T[i].date, T[j].date)) <= 3) return -T[i].amt; return 0; })()
